purpose: shared game mesh for chair_lift carriers in playable/lift-graphics.js
required_parts: seat and back for four riders
relations: grip is the origin and sits on the cable
hanger runs down from the grip to the crossbar
seat surface is 2.55 m below the grip
riders face Blender -Y, which is glTF +Z after Y-up export
restraint and footrest are in front of the seat, toward travel
style: original, not a copied chairlift model

finish.profile: game-ready smooth within a hard triangle ceiling
surface_targets: round tubes read as steel from the slope
cushions read darker than the frame against snow
metal and seat share one albedo

review_questions: Does the silhouette read as a quad chair from the front, side, and three-quarter?
Does the hanger clearly connect the grip to the crossbar?
Does the gray steel stay visible against snow?
